definitions.explanation: Describes how something appears or the manner in which something is done.
Used to make comparisons or indicate similarity.
Expresses purpose or aim when followed by に.

examples.japanese: {分|わ}かるように{説明|せつめい}してください。
examples.english: Please explain so that I can understand.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{怒|おこ}っているようです。

notes: よう is versatile: 1) ～のよう (like, similar to), 2) ～ようだ/です (seems like, appears to be), 3) ～ように (in order to, so that). The kanji 様 can be used. Related patterns: ような (like a ~), ように (like, in the manner of; so that), ようにする (to make sure to), ようになる (to come to be able to).
